title: Probes: new features on drawn elements
blurb: 27 short tests of recent CSS and DOM features on elements that a canvas draws: carousels, anchor positioning, corner-shape, HDR colour, :visited, permission elements.
question: Do recent CSS and DOM features take effect on an element that a canvas draws?
result: Shapes, carets, highlights, scroll markers and scroll-driven animations do. Popovers are not in the picture, links are drawn as unvisited, and permission elements report that they are distorted.
